name: US states - hard (AI-written, not yet reviewed)
description: 21 HARD questions on us states, written by Claude as an add-on to the easier 'US states' review pack (which has almost no hard ones). Every question and answer needs checking by a person before anybody plays it.

source.name: Written by hand by Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) on 2026-10-05, from its own knowledge plus the pages each item cites: no API call. Every cited page was fetched on 2026-10-05 by a script that confirmed it loads and that its text contains the answer or the key words named in the item's source note (a check that the page is about the fact, not a full fact-check). Items resting on no page say "common knowledge" and why. Fact-check pending: no item carries `checked` yet; a separate fact-check pass adds it. A person still reviews it by playing.

review.how: Check every question, answer and explanation. Fix or delete what is wrong, set status to 'reviewed' with your name and the date, then move the file to packs/ and list it in pack_library.js.
